notes: *as well as* is kept whole on `עִם` as one rendering of that preposition and headed on *well* under rule 24's fixed-phrase clause, since no word in the phrase realizes the preposition's own lexeme and the head is never one of its connectives.
The assimilated article of `כַּבָּקָר` is `unrepresented`: the ASV renders the noun indefinitely (rules 12, 29).
